exposure: prenatal antibiotics (doxycycline, human antibiotics/preferred as human antibiotics (HAs/PHAs), sulfamethazine)
finding: Maternal exposure to doxycycline and HAs/PHAs during the first trimester, and sulfamethazine during the second trimester for girls, was associated with an increased risk of ADHD symptoms in preschoolers, with maternal vitamin D deficiency exacerbating the adverse effects of doxycycline exposure.
